name: What is a critical path in construction scheduling?
description: The critical path is the sequence of tasks that must finish on time for a project to meet its deadline; delays here affect overall completion.

mainEntity.name: What is a critical path in construction scheduling?

acceptedAnswer.text: The critical path in construction scheduling identifies the sequence of tasks that must be completed on time for the entire project to meet its deadline. Any delay in a critical path task will directly delay the project's completion. Understanding the critical path allows us to prioritize resources and monitor these key activities closely. As part of our first-party insight, our project managers specifically highlight these critical tasks during planning, offering clients clarity on which stages are most time-sensitive and require careful attention.
